children: Hugo Boss's lowered outlook could weigh on U.K. retailer Frasers Group, RBC Capital Markets' Manjari Dhar and Richard Chamberlain write in a note. The German company reduced its full-year earnings forecast, given higher expenses and softer consumer demand expectations. "We think this is a negative read for Frasers Group, the majority owner of Hugo Boss," the analysts say. Consumer demand has softened recently in a number of key markets, they add. "We expect renewed momentum for Hugo Boss from 2027, but visibility on this is low, especially given ongoing geopolitical uncertainty," RBC says. (andrea.figueras@wsj.com)
